content: Sia s3d (v0.2.1, Oct 2026): S3-compatible renter on Sia Storage SDK; all objects first written to a local uploads directory on disk, SQLite metadata; background loop bin-packs pending objects into groups and uploads to Sia when waste falls below threshold (default 10%); erasure coding applied at group upload, not at object receipt; so a returned-200 PUT means staged-locally, not yet durable on Sia hosts. Observability: admin API GET /stats/uploads JSON + /prometheus upload-pipeline metrics; sia.diskUsageLimit caps pending-buffer bytes (default 10 GiB). Conditional requests: PutObject/CopyObject/CompleteMultipartUpload honor If-Match and If-None-Match atomically with the write; DeleteObject honors If-Match incl. * plus x-amz-if-match-size/-last-modified-time; GetObject/HeadObject honor full read preconditions; versioning + ListObjectVersions supported; multipart with 5 MiB min part.
